text: Text Mode Pixel Theme 是面向 DSH 网页端的像素风外观插件。它通过客户端主题接口覆盖界面颜色与样式，并在左侧栏加入 Pixel theme 页面。用户可以选择 12 种 ASCII 场景壁纸，设置浅色、深色或跟随系统的外观，也可以关闭皮肤而不禁用插件；自动场景会随当前明暗模式切换。壁纸由浏览器 Canvas 绘制，选择和开关状态保存在本地浏览器中。适合希望给 DSH 网页界面增加复古终端视觉、并自行切换场景的用户；安装时需要通过 Harness 插件管理器载入 bundle。

Text Mode Pixel Theme gives the DSH web UI pixel styles and sidebar controls. Choose from 12 ASCII wallpaper scenes, set light, dark, or system appearance, or turn the skin off. Auto scene follows appearance; choices stay in browser storage. Install the bundle with the Harness plugin manager.
想给 DSH 网页版换成复古像素风，还能选不同的动态 ASCII 壁纸。
DSH 页面能不能加个侧边栏设置，让我切换壁纸和明暗主题？
I want a retro pixel look and selectable ASCII wallpaper scenes in the DSH web interface.
Text Mode Pixel Theme 的功能「侧栏主题与壁纸控制」：在左侧栏打开 Pixel theme 页面后，可切换浅色、深色或系统外观，选择 ASCII 场景，并随时开关整套皮肤。

@local/textmode-pixel-theme README · Features：- **12 live ASCII wallpapers:** Auto, Koi pond, Honu lagoon, Moonlit, Cloud
  drift, Fireflies, Jellyfish, Lantern night, Neon rain, Sakura dusk, Snow
  cabin, Star voyage, and Clawd.
- **Light / dark / system** from the same page (writes the built-in Appearance
  preference) plus **Auto** wallpaper that follows it.
- A **Pixel theme** page in the left sidebar switches scenes, sets the mode, or
  turns the skin off without disabling the plugin. The choice is stored in
  `localStorage`.
- Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` (draws a still frame).
- MIT. The ASCII scene engine and the wallpapers are adapted from
  [ai-chat-themes](https://github.com/Aohkne/ai-chat-themes); see
  [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).

@local/textmode-pixel-theme README · Install：This directory is a Harness plugin bundle. Install it with the plugin manager
(for example `plugin_manager install_bundle` with this absolute directory), then
restart or hard-refresh the Web UI. The **Pixel theme** icon appears in the left
sidebar rail; Settings → Appearance still handles light/dark.

@local/textmode-pixel-theme README · Layout：| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | Bundle manifest and `dsh.client` entry. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the plugin row. |
| `index.js` | Host half (no host behavior). |
| `client.js` | The whole skin: theme tokens, CSS, ASCII scene engine, sidebar page. |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | Plugin Manager title and description. |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin icon. |
| `NOTICE.md` | Third-party MIT attribution. |
